_說明: 市場解讀清單。每兩星期：① 把 PDF 放入 content/updates/（檔名用英文或數字，例如 2026-11-02.pdf）；② 喺下面 posts 最頂加一項。status：published（公開）或 draft（草稿）。highlights 係 3–5 句重點，會直接寫入網頁俾搜尋引擎同讀者睇（建議填寫，唔填都得）。部署時會自動生成 /updates/<id>/ 頁面。 英文版：每期加 title_en、summary_en、highlights_en（同 highlights 一樣多句）、period_en；PDF 用中文都得。

posts.title: 雙週市場速遞：AI 晶片股急跌、油價重上 110 美元、各地央行未敢放鬆
posts.title_en: Fortnightly market notes: AI chip stocks slide, oil back at US$110, central banks hold off on easing
posts.summary: 納指錄 6 月以來最差一週，資金由科技股流向傳統板塊；布蘭特期油重上 110 美元；美國 9 月 CPI 升至 3.7%，三大央行月底議息。
posts.summary_en: The Nasdaq had its worst week since June as money rotated from tech into traditional sectors; Brent crude climbed back to US$110; US September CPI rose to 3.7%, with three major central banks meeting at the end of the month.
highlights: 納斯達克指數一週跌 4.5%，係 6 月以嚟最差一週；晶片股連跌 8 日
布蘭特期油重上每桶 110 美元，中東同俄烏局勢令供應憂慮升溫
美國 9 月 CPI 按年升 3.7%，高過預期；聯儲局 9 月已加息至 3.75%–4.00%
恒指兩週大致喺 24,000 點附近上落，恒生科技指數較弱
10 月 28 至 30 日美國、歐洲、日本三大央行相繼議息，值得留意
highlights_en: The Nasdaq fell 4.5% in a week, its worst week since June; chip stocks fell for 8 days in a row
Brent crude futures climbed back to US$110 a barrel as the Middle East and Russia–Ukraine situations heightened supply worries
US September CPI rose 3.7% year on year, above expectations; the Fed raised rates to 3.75%–4.00% in September
The Hang Seng Index hovered around 24,000 over the two weeks, with the Hang Seng Tech Index weaker
The US, European and Japanese central banks meet in turn from 28 to 30 October, worth watching
